where.if: AND (component_name LIKE '%' || #{query.keyword} || '%' OR component_name_cn LIKE '%' || #{query.keyword} || '%' OR agent_ui_dsl LIKE '%' || #{query.keyword} || '%' OR owner LIKE '%' || #{query.keyword} || '%' OR scene LIKE '%' || #{query.keyword} || '%')

mapper.select: SELECT id, asset_type, component_name, component_name_cn, dsl_type, protocol_version, owner, scene, coalesce(enabled, 0) = 1 AS enabled, update_time FROM skill_component_registry ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
